@commonClose.description: A button that closes a dialog.

@commonOpen.description: A button that shows a folder in Finder or Explorer.

appNoConfigDir: Can't find the system's configuration directory
appDataFileUnavailable: Can't open the data file, so settings and projects won't be saved this time: {error}

@appChooseFolder.description: The title of the dialog that picks the folder new chats work in.

@appSettingsWindowTitle.description: The title of the settings window.

@chatNewChat.description: The button, sidebar item and title of a chat not started yet.

@chatList.description: The sidebar list of chats, and its section when there is no project.

@chatConnectedCount.description: Beside Settings in the sidebar: how many providers have a credential.

chatEmptyWhereFull: Pi works in {path} and can read and write files and run commands.
chatEmptyWhereReadOnly: Pi works in {path} and only reads files, never changes them.
chatSuggestStructurePrompt: Look at how the project in this directory is organized and give me a short overview.
chatSuggestTodosPrompt: Find every TODO and FIXME in the code and list them by file.
chatSuggestReadmePrompt: Read the README and sum up this project in three sentences.
chatSuggestExplainPrompt: Pick the most central source file and explain its main logic.
chatConnectBody: Sign in with a subscription such as ChatGPT, Claude or GitHub Copilot, or enter an API key from any provider.

chatRetrying: The request failed. Retrying in {seconds, number, ::.0} s ({attempt}/{max}): {error}

@chatRetrying.description: A notice in the chat while a failed request waits to be sent again.

chatCompacting: The context is long. Compacting the history…
chatToolReadOnly: {tool} is not available in a read-only chat: it may change files or run commands. Switch the chat to full tool access to use it.

@chatToolReadOnly.description: The result of a tool call a read-only chat refuses, which the model and the tool card show.

composerPlaceholder: Message Pi. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line
composerPlaceholderBusy: Follow-ups are sent after this reply…

@composerLabel.description: The accessible name of the text field messages are written in.

composerChatCwdTooltip: This chat's working directory: {path}. Choosing another directory starts a new chat
composerChatToolsTooltip: This chat's tool access. Switching it starts a new chat
composerNewChatReadOnly: Started a new chat that only reads files
composerNewChatFull: Started a new chat that can read and write files and run commands
composerNewChatsFull: New chats can read and write files and run commands
composerStoppedDraftRestored: Stopped. The messages not sent yet are back in the message box

@thinkingLabel.description: The composer's button of the reasoning effort.

@messageThinking.description: Shown before a reply has any text.

@messageThoughts.description: The button that shows the model's reasoning, once it is done.

@messageThoughtsLive.description: The button that shows the model's reasoning, while it reasons.
